title: Directional Adhesion
description: Understand how gecko-inspired microstructures create strong shear grip, easy peel release, and new classes of reversible dry adhesives.

learning_objectives.statement: Understand the physics of intermolecular forces (van der Waals) in biological systems
Examine surface area manipulation in setal structures
Apply directional adhesion principles to dry adhesive engineering

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
